messages:
sam_runtime: heads up — tenant `zeta-inc` reported increased tail latency after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout. p95 token latency up ~35%, queue depth spikes during bursts. asking for dedicated token-budget / queue-policy adjustments so customer doesn't see errors. pinging @maya_ml and @jordi_infra :wave:

maya_ml: noted. i ran a quick profile; the selector picked `attn_kernel_v2` which is faster for long seqs but increases KV-cache miss amplification on short-chatty sessions. miss_rate jumped from 0.08 -> 0.21 for zeta's default shard. this increases per-request token work which blows their token budget.

jordi_infra: can you paste the flame or the perf counter dump? also we should know their current queue_policy/target_token_budget before we change anything.

sam_runtime: here's the small dump from the canary node (sanitized):
```
# perf counters (sample)
kernel_selector: attn_kernel_v2
seq_len_dist: median=32 mean=45 p95=112
kv_cache: hits=79k misses=21k miss_rate=0.21
batching: avg_batch_size=6 avg_wait_ms=18
token_budget_target=1200 tokens/min/client
p95_token_latency=185ms (was 138ms pre-rollout)
error: queue_rejected=42 (5m)
```

maya_ml: thanks. two quick levers: 1) reduce token_budget_target for that dedicated pool from 1200 -> 900 for a short window, 2) tighten queue formation so `max_wait_ms` -> 10 and bump `min_batch_size` -> 4 to avoid many small batches triggering kernel overhead. both should reduce token churn and lower p95. also we can pin that shard to `attn_kernel_v1` for zeta while we refine kernel_v2 heuristics.

priya_sre: cautious — reducing token budget can cause throttling errors tracked by their app. recommend a canary: apply adjustments to 10% of their capacity and feed into the existing rollout rollback hook. i'll set an alert for queue_rejected > 10 in 5m.

jordi_infra: agree with canary. operational checklist:
- create dedicated config revision `zeta-batch-tweak-2026-03-17`
- set token_budget_target=900
- set queue_policy: { max_wait_ms:10, min_batch_size:4, max_queue_depth:400 }
- optional: kernel_pin=attn_kernel_v1 for shard-a

sam_runtime: can one of you run the CLI change? i'm short today. quick command i use: `rwctl dedicated apply --tenant zeta --revision zeta-batch-tweak-2026-03-17 --from-file zeta.json` where zeta.json has the above fields.

jordi_infra: i'll kick it off in 2m and wire the canary to 10%. will post results.

deploy-bot: deploy started for revision zeta-batch-tweak-2026-03-17 -> dedicated-pool/zeta (canary=10%). CI checks passed.

sam_runtime: thanks. if this looks good after 30m with improved p95 and no surge in throttles, we can expand to 50%.

maya_ml: follow-up note — we should also add a short-term heuristic in kernel-selector: if seq_len p95 < 128 and kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.15, prefer `attn_kernel_v1`. i'll open a tiny PR to land that as toggle-gated.

priya_sre: FYI i've added an alert and a slack webhook to this thread for any regressions. :white_check_mark:

jordi_infra: canary steady after 18m: p95 token latency down to 148ms, kv miss rate unchanged (0.20) but queue_rejected dropped to 3. no user-visible errors reported by zeta support. i'll keep it running and escalate if anything flips.

sam_runtime: perfect — leave the canary + alert in place and let's track 1h. maya, thx for the selector tweak PR.

maya_ml: on it. will link PR here when ready.

jordi_infra: note for postmortem: we should add a short-profile step to the kernel rollout job that computes kv_cache impact for top tenants. would have caught this earlier.

sam_runtime: agreed. logging that as an action item. thanks team. :pray:
